narrationTexts: Confirmed the bug: `orderTotal` taxes the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted total.
finalText:
**Fixed. 625/625 passing.**

`orderTotal` in [src/pricing.js:41](src/pricing.js:41) was taxing the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted total. Changed `roundCents(cents * taxRate)` to `roundCents(discounted * taxRate)`.

Nothing else broken, no next step needed.
